description: Workspace ONE UEM is a software that provides unified endpoint management capabilities, allowing organizations to manage and secure devices across various operating systems from a single console. The software enables device configuration, application management, andcompliance monitoring for smartphones, tablets, laptops, and rugged devices. Workspace ONE UEM supports integration with existing IT systems, automates device provisioning, and applies security policies to safeguard corporate data. It addresses the business need for centralized device management and helps ensure policy enforcement and regulatory compliance across diverse hardware platforms within enterprise environments.
